messages:
auditor_jenn: Hi - prepping SOC 2 fieldwork. Need a consolidated evidence bundle for 2026-03-08..2026-03-14: RBAC change history, KMS rotation proof, vuln triage for CVE-2026-0101, and incident response artifacts. Can we schedule a short Zoom to walk through?
sarah-sec: @auditor_jenn we can do that. I will build a bundle and redact user identifiers. ETA EOD today unless you want raw logs.
auditor_jenn: Raw logs preferred; redacted IDs OK. We can sign a limited-scope NDA if needed for sensitive material.
mike-oncall: I have an exporter. Run: `./scripts/export_audit_bundle.sh --start 2026-03-08 --end 2026-03-14 --include=kms,rbac,vuln,incident --dest=s3://redwood-audit-uploads/auditor_jenn/` It will create a tar.gz and a 72h presigned URL.
rob-eng: For RBAC we will include CloudTrail + authz-service audit. Sample event (anonymized): ```{"user":"maya","action":"role.bind","resource":"proj/serve","ts":"2026-03-11T10:12:33Z","req":"req-9a8b"}``` Also will add CSV mapping to PR/issue that triggered change.
sarah-sec: KMS note: CMK `redwood-prod-01` rotated 2026-03-12T02:03:12Z. We'll include rotation event, key-policy diffs, and envelope unwrap entries showing principals that performed decrypt. Key material stays in HSM.
auditor_jenn: Please include a control mapping CSV linking artifacts to SOC2 control IDs (e.g., CC6, CC7) and ISO references. That speeds review.
rob-eng: Vuln triage timeline: scanner alert 2026-03-09T04:22Z, triaged same day, PR #341 merged 2026-03-10, canary deploy 2026-03-11, full deploy 2026-03-11T18:00Z. We'll attach PR, CI logs, and canary metrics.
mike-oncall: I'll put a short README in the bundle (checksums, file list, redaction notes) and post the presigned URL when upload completes. I can do a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @auditor_jenn? :thumbsup:
auditor_jenn: 09:00 UTC works. Thanks — please post the URL and README here once done.
